units.source_text: 再想一想村里人们的行径，我的损失，怎么算都计算不过来呢。

en.t: When I thought again about the villagers' conduct, there was no way to calculate the losses I had suffered.

units.source_text: 我们两人之间个人的借贷根本不是问题。

en.t: The personal debts between the two of us were not the issue at all.
In any case, I meant to take thorough revenge...

units.source_text: 只是怎么做才能给予最大的打击，这一点还不十分清楚……

en.t: Only, I was still not quite sure what I should do to strike the hardest blow...

units.source_text: 最初打算放一把火烧了村子；

en.t: At first I thought of setting a fire and burning down the village;
of putting poison into the well;

units.source_text: 搭一个陷阱，引诱责任者从边上掉进洞穴里去。

en.t: of setting a trap and luring the people responsible into falling from the edge into the hole.

units.source_text: 以这种直接的手段，专门来鞭策空想，激励自己，

en.t: With such direct methods, I was merely whipping up my fantasies and spurring myself on,

units.source_text: 可是，一旦真有了实行的机会，就不会说这种孩子气的话了。

en.t: but once a real chance to carry them out appeared, I would no longer talk such childish nonsense.

units.source_text: 反正个人的暴力等等，也就那么点儿小事。

en.t: After all, personal violence and the like amounted to nothing more than a petty matter.
It seemed that I had no choice but to appeal to the law.

units.source_text: 那时，这事件残酷程度之意义，究竟在法律上，能够理解到什么程度，多少还有些悬念……

en.t: Even then, there was still some uncertainty about how far the law would be able to grasp the meaning of this incident's cruelty...

units.source_text: 算啦，至少先找县里的警察，送上各种报告。

en.t: Well then, at least I would first go to the prefectural police and submit the various reports.
